name: Peace And Love
overview: Scripture teaches that true peace and love are gifts from Christ that surpass worldly understanding and circumstances, offering believers comfort and courage amid trials. Believers are called to be peacemakers, reflecting God's character as His children, and to embody wisdom that is pure, peaceable, gentle, and merciful. The New Testament emphasizes that mercy, peace, and love are to be continually multiplied within the community of faith, demonstrating the transformative power of the gospel.
